title: Restricted Soil-Temperature Transactional Runtime Composition
goal: Compose the already-qualified restricted soil-temperature capability into the serialized reference runtime without changing its science, using the same outer transaction as soil water so water and thermal state publish or roll back together.
required_semantics: capture hydraulic start view before Richards mutation and hydraulic end view after a converged Richards trial
run restricted soil temperature only after the water solve has converged
thermal rejection fails the same transaction attempt; no water-only publication is possible
accepted attempts publish water and temperature together through the existing kernel candidate commit
inactive columns carry no allocated thermal physical state and no persistent thermal scratch
thermal workspace belongs to the worker-local backend model
restart persists thermal continuation through the existing polymorphic committed-state persistence path
runtime and process communicate through process_hydraulic_view_t rather than HeadCalc internals
water mass accounting remains authoritative and unchanged by sensible-heat accounting
hard_holds: no change to qualified soil-temperature process equations or constitutive formulas
no claim of parallel throughput qualification
no implicit day or midnight boundary
qualification_matrix: thermal-disabled path preserves existing runtime behavior
enabled single-column water plus thermal success
thermal failure rolls back water and temperature
retry starts again from the same committed water and temperature state
water mass residual identity with thermal disabled and no thermal mass term when enabled
